status: User-supplied combined resource hourly rates. IXL September 2026 material baseline first; estimate close materials, research substantially different materials online. Process setup/throughput and coating allowance are provisional.
hourly_rate_basis: Single source: resources.<id>.labour_per_hour + machine_per_hour. Calculator sums these once. One operator; do not add labour again. Process throughput is estimated separately.
routine_inspection_packing_basis: Provisional combined 30 seconds/assembly or faster when justified. Commercially absorb routine labour equivalent in pricing margin and disclose effective margin after absorption; price special inspection or packaging explicitly.
fallback_cycle_basis: Uncalibrated planning assumptions; replace with measured rates or an explicit time build-up. Do not apply uniformly to large or unusually complex work.
resource_selection: Default laser=LVD 2.5Kw; bend=LVD 3m; weld=B48 MIG; manual=B54 bench. Select Dynapress, clinch or turret only when the route is feasible. Paint-line hourly rate is not an e-coat unit price or proof of coating capability; use only for confirmed applicable paint-line routes.
material_pricing_policy: Read material-pricing.md and ixl-material-baseline.json. User current prices > exact IXL baseline > defensible close-material estimate > researched online prices. Preserve unconfirmed source price units/GST. Internet benchmarks are secondary and must be refreshed before use.

material_price_benchmarks.basis: Public retail, local pickup, order in; refresh before reuse
Public retail benchmark; excludes delivery; refresh before reuse

selling_price_basis: Manufacturing cost / (1 - gross margin). Default 28% gross margin, not markup. Display profit and selling price separately; exclude GST.

ecoat_reference.status: Historical example only; not an automatic default
ecoat_reference.applicability: No validated size, weight, batch or performance envelope has been supplied. Do not reuse without explicit user confirmation for this job or a documented comparable supplier quote. Otherwise use a justified scenario range or mark unpriced.
